# Test Matrix Type

![Test Matrix Type function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/math/linear-algebra/14-test_matrix_type.svg)

[Mathematics functions](../../mathematics/index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Tests a matrix property without conversion. GS explicit codes: 0 diagonal, 1 lower triangular, 2 upper triangular, 3 symmetric, 4 Hermitian, 5 positive definite, 6 positive semidefinite. These codes are GS projection, not certified NI enum codes. Negative relative tolerance selects a scale-aware cutoff. Inputs calculate in DBL/CDB with explicit numeric promotion; 64-bit integers above 2^53 may round. No broadcasting, no private Matrix reinterpretation. error is I32 and never an automatic dialog. Optional unwired defaults: matrix_type=0, tolerance=-1.
